traps: Rejected proposal (lines 51-55): Omar proposes releasing Android first and iOS a week later; Lina, Sara and Rami object and he withdraws it. The decision is both platforms on the same day (line 56).
Self-correction (line 60): Sara first says Thursday 16, then corrects herself to Wednesday 15 April because of server maintenance on Thursday. Thursday 16 is wrong.

Dates that are not deadlines: 9 April was the old plan that cannot be met (line 48), 2 March was the last rushed release (line 49), 10 April is when Khaled is back from travel (line 62); 'last Thursday' is when staging went down (line 30).
Moved task (lines 38-45): collecting beta-tester feedback is first taken by Rami (line 40), then Lina takes it because Rami has the regression (lines 41-44). The owner is Lina, due Sunday.
No deadline (lines 77-78): Lina's final dashboard mockups; 'not before the release' is not a deadline and Sara says there is no deadline.
Not a decision (lines 65-67): an open beta for all users is left to think about after the release.
Not actions: the Arabic font bug was already fixed yesterday (line 20); asking Khaled before fixing the date is dropped because he said it is the team's call (lines 62-63).
Open, not decided: whether clients will see the dashboard (79-82) and who is on call the weekend after the release (83-85).
